records.claim: Diazepam passes into breast milk in small amounts. Diazepam can stay in the body longer than some other benzodiazepine medications. If you use diazepam regularly while breastfeeding, there is a chance it could build up in the baby’s system. This might cause sleepiness or affect your child’s weight gain. If you suspect the baby has any symptoms like trouble feeding, breathing, gaining weight, being too sleepy, or hyperbilirubinemia, contact the child’s healthcare provider.
